headline: Chery's Omoda & Jaecoo Weigh Argentine Auto Production and Lithium Access
summary: Chinese automaker Chery's brands Omoda and Jaecoo are entering Argentina directly and considering acquiring an existing plant or building a new manufacturing facility while expressing interest in local lithium resources.
why: Chinese automotive manufacturers are accelerating their direct footprint in Latin America to secure electric vehicle supply chains and access lithium reserves.

impacts.name: Chery
impacts.why: Direct entry and potential plant investments expand Chery's South American manufacturing footprint.
